statement: Counterexamples to Ryser’s covering conjecture. Disproves Ryser's covering conjecture by constructing intersecting $`(q+1)`$-partite, $`(q+1)`$-uniform hypergraphs with covering number $`q+1`$, rather than the predicted bound q, for every sufficiently large prime q. A separate construction over extension fields also disproves Gyárfás's monochromatic tree-cover conjecture.
